_comment: TED Search API v3 client configuration. The API is free and keyless (POST, anonymous). fields_superset lists candidate eForms field names; the extractor probes them at startup and automatically drops names the API rejects (each drop is logged to CLEANING_LOG.md). query_templates are tried in order on a tiny window until one returns HTTP 200; {iso3}/{d0}/{d1}/{cpv} are substituted. politeness_sleep_s is the pause between successive requests; the API is a public good - do not hammer it.
query_templates: (classification-cpv IN ({cpv}*)) AND buyer-country={iso3} AND publication-date>={d0} AND publication-date<={d1}
classification-cpv={cpv}* AND buyer-country={iso3} AND publication-date>={d0} AND publication-date<={d1}
(classification-cpv IN ({cpv}000000)) AND buyer-country={iso3} AND publication-date>={d0} AND publication-date<={d1}
_query_templates_comment: Template 1-2: server-side CPV division filter (wildcard) - preferred, small volume. Template 3: parent-code filter, works only if the API expands the CPV hierarchy server-side; the extractor VALIDATES this by checking that returned notices actually carry non-728xx/72xx children before trusting it. Template 4: LAST RESORT - no CPV filter, full country-month volume, client-side filtering; the extractor asks for confirmation via --allow-unfiltered before using it.
